native_inventory.renderer_ownership: KeyguardOrbBufferRenderer Main side creates/reparents/hides a non-input child SurfaceControl under the retained root, validates exact attachment/material/privacy lease identity, and never waits for worker completion. native_inventory.live_boundary: onIsolatedOrbFirstPublished accepts only current attached lease output; it makes the isolated route LIVE and suppresses the duplicate legacy View producer. Old lease, detached or privacy-invalid results return before publication.
